notes: Hollow Choir rooms (#50): cathedral pillars, pews, the memorial and final doors, obelisk statues, candles, lanterns, plates, chalices, the iron rail and debris. Every GLB references the shared Textures/colormap.png; HollowChoir.tsx renders them with a cold-tinted copy of that texture (the iron rail uses a plain iron material).
